body:
domain:skills#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH

⚠️ **Seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` (⛔ not copied here). This is **`domain:skills` seat 3**, added by `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈新增座位贴〉 (highest existing seat number in the lane, 2, plus one). Seat 1 is #7623 and seat 2 is #19287; ⛔ this post is neither.

## Current PM

🟢 **`os-support-ai`** (`GET /user`) · `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH` (project thread "Run PM dispatch skills lane" in the os-support-ai account's project "objectstack spec"), seated 2026-11-03. Summons: the maintainer (Yibo Wang, `os-support-ai`), verbatim 「再开一个skills 车道，并发3」 (2026-11-03T03:11Z, in this account's project).

- **Why a new seat, not seat 2:** #19287's title reads `⏳ vacant`, but its newest event is an opening mark by another session (6591325412, `os-justin`, on-demand) after the clock-out brief, and that session now also holds `security#1` (#29740). Rather than run the conservative confirmation against a live session, this seat is added beside it.
- **Patrol:** `trig_011ERyx1eCGSkjwUkqHqfMG3` · `17 * * * *` (hourly, self-bound to the seat session).
- **Mailbox:** PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#29749 (`Mailbox-of: domain:skills#3 · os-support-ai`), subscribed.
- **Concurrency:** at most THREE active dev cards in this seat (「并发3」).
- **Contract reviews:** run in-seat at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` as an isolated reviewer (the maintainer, 2026-11-03: the at-tier model is available to every lane).
- Posture, ledger and round reports live in the project (pointer only). Lane ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:skills#3` + `head:claude/` PRs.

## Hot-file serial queue

⛔ Re-derive from the live `Claim:` comments and each open PR's file list before every dispatch; read #7623 and #19287 too.

- Resumed 2026-11-03T15:41Z: the maintainer, verbatim 「车队可以继续派发了，只派发 p1 p2 ，总并发不超过 20」. This seat takes `priority:p1` and `priority:p2` cards only, at most three at once.
- In flight: none. ⏸ **Paused** 2026-11-03T22:36Z: the maintainer, verbatim 「skills 车道暂停」. No claims or dispatch, patrol off, until the maintainer resumes the lane.
- Landed: PR #29825 (#29663); PR #29850 (#29741); PR #29862 (#29646); PR #29864 (#29482); PR #29887 (#29754); PR #29832 (#29367); PR #29939 (#29731); PR #29941 (#29445); PR #29940 (#29682) 2026-11-03T17:55Z; PR #29967 (#29242) 2026-11-03T19:52Z. Cards closed, `pm:dispatched` removed.
- Declined: #29402 (sibling escalation from triage, held by seat 1), 6600746908, because of the release pause.

## Notes

- **Publication:** objectstack. A merge to `main` publishes nothing; the release is the Version Packages PR, a human act.
- **Split with seats 1 and 2:** first claim wins; this seat re-reads the other seats' live `Claim:` comments before claiming and ⛔ never takes a card another seat has claimed.
- A `skills/**` PR owes an `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset, never `skip-changeset`.
- Write path: the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
